conveyor.scope: Local filesystem transitions only; existing training guard, canonical lock, actual-exit observation and evaluator remain authoritative.
contracts_read: Exclusive transition-directory creation serializes claims and transitions; stale/busy locks fail closed and are never stolen. Existing running packets block every new claim.
Task/source/control/input/split/evaluator pins, budget types and dependency review conditions are checked before admission. Claim hashes the task and assigns no experiment clock.

Only complete known terminal packets move into results. Missing artifacts, absent actual-exit/cleanup declarations, live or explicitly uncertain ownership prevent publication; failed/timeout/OOM/interrupted statuses remain representable.
Task, claim, receipt, metrics, closure and summary are sealed before publication. Review revalidates task lineage and all sealed bytes; reviewed dependencies bind both task and terminal-seal hash.
Source and destination queue paths reject links/junction escape at the transition checks. No subprocess, ML launch, retry, requeue or clock-reset action exists.
resolved_findings: Published task and terminal evidence mutation was previously accepted before review; current review verifies the claim/receipt task lineage and terminal file seal.
Explicit uncertain ownership was previously ignored; current publication rejects nonempty uncertain_owned.
Rename destinations previously bypassed the existing inside() invariant; promote, publish and review now check their destinations.
Reviewed dependencies now bind the terminal-seal file digest, preventing silent seal regeneration after review.
boundaries: Metrics are an opaque preserved payload. This helper does not certify finite/null/per-cut quality semantics or independently establish the truth of a runtime closure receipt.
A completed dependency means any reviewed experiment, including a negative or failed result. An accepted dependency requires an accepted review.
A transition interrupted after writing claim or seal can require explicit inspection; no automatic recovery is provided.
This is a cooperative local filesystem integrity contract, not an OS sandbox or an adversarial authorization service.

tests.scope: Source inspection of lifecycle, serial claims, lock preservation, admission, dependencies, mutation, partial/unclean publication, timeout-null preservation, seal and uncertain-ownership cases. No test pass is claimed here.

contracts_read: Only implemented catalog profiles may be proposed; library availability is not adapter readiness.
Exact SVM, bounded RBF approximation and polynomial expansion are distinguished, with dimensions/memory/time and probability-training costs checked before admission.
Preprocessing and learned transforms fit only appropriate fitting rows at every split/refit. Validation/test information and outer-label calibration are excluded.

The first representation comparison preserves the learner/preparation control; later hyperparameters and weights remain separate factors. Target metric, splits, target transformation, original-scale evaluation, row/class order and probability validity remain fixed.

Inner evidence requires provenance; diversity and component screens do not establish whole-agent gain. Failures and missing predictions remain explicit/null, with full procedure/refit/CSV audit required before portfolio expansion.
kernel_skill.boundary: Generic Codex instructions only; validation/installation or this review does not prove Qwen backend integration, implemented kernel adapters, model gain or execution readiness.
